title: Santa Monica Roller Coaster Mountain Bike Tour (Intermediate)
includes: Premium mountain bike gear, helmet and eyewear
2025 Specialized Kenevo Expert Electric Mountain Bike
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Travelers should have a high level of physical fitness
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Join us on a unique electric mountain biking adventure through shaded sycamore forests and spring-fed streams in the Santa Monica Mountains. Ride top-tier bikes from Husqvarna, Specialized, and Haibike. The trail features both beginner-friendly fire roads and an optional “Ridgeline Roller Coaster” singletrack, so riders of all levels can explore side-by-side. Enjoy sweeping views of the Pacific Ocean and mountain ranges as we make our way to the historic Nike Missile Control Site—an iconic Cold War landmark. This local-favorite route offers an authentic glimpse into Santa Monica’s vibrant mountain biking scene.
